title: Feat/health and fixes
body: ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Relay Health screen (by-status / by-plane) with keyboard controls (h, Esc, Tab, j/k, r) and help hints. * Relay lists in Group and Profile views; account/group relay loading and health/error reporting. * Loading indicators for chats, messages, and search ("Searching..."). * **Improvements** * Viewport-aware message scrolling with visible-range tracking; health state resets on navigation. * **Bug Fixes** * JSON stream parsing now yields complete values before stopping on an incomplete tail.
